listing.name: Tobal 2 Recompiled
listing.summary: Build Tobal 2 from your Japanese PlayStation disc using upstream’s Windows, Linux or Mac setup kit.
listing.download_block_reason: Portcove downloads are on hold while the contents and provenance of the bundled English disc overlay are reviewed. You can use this guide with a setup kit you have permission to use.

steps.title: Prepare your disc and matching setup kit
steps.instruction: Use an unmodified Tobal 2 Japan v1.1 disc (SLPM-86033). Keep its single-track BIN and paired CUE together. The BIN SHA-256 is 04e79535b4616963e045957b4f9b87126753e94b01d35d32c60214df04bf5a5a. Extract the v0.2.6 kit for Windows x64, Linux x64, Intel Mac or Apple Silicon into a writable folder.

steps.title: Build the game on your computer
steps.instruction: Open Tobal_2_Recompiled from the extracted kit (Tobal_2_Recompiled.exe on Windows). On Mac install Apple’s Command Line Tools first. Select your CUE, choose Generate & rebuild and allow Internet access for first-run tools. After the build, choose English or Japanese and press PLAY in the upstream launcher.

steps.title: Keep your memory cards before changing kits
steps.instruction: Preserve the extracted kit and its saves and build-release/saves folders wherever they exist. Keep the original disc files separately. Upstream reports that memory cards have yet to be verified in every mode.
